compiled_artifact: same unchanged artifact as corrected wider qualification
limits: Counts are sampled stack observations, not exclusive CPU time, CPU shares or elapsed-time fractions.
All target-process threads are included, including waiting and background threads.
B/M/D references and queries run alongside between-call decoding, DTO conversion, hashing, assertions and logging; no baseline-only or per-arm attribution is supported.
Different family-presence counts overlap on reconstructed stacks and must not be added.
Marker receipt cursors are watcher observations, not query execution timestamps or per-stack arm assignments.
The optimized debug0 artifact may inline or omit separate cosine and magnitude symbols; missing names do not establish absence of work or norm-specific cost.
Profiler overhead and normal desktop/shared-service background activity make these instrumented timings unsuitable for performance qualification or causal attribution.
These captures do not establish a scalar-cache benefit, production adoption or issue closure.
stack_presence_count_method: For each terminal observation count each family present anywhere on its reconstructed stack once; distinct families overlap and are not additive.
terminal_count_method: Subtract immediate child counts from each printed call-tree node; nonnegative residuals reconcile to each thread root under one broad symbol-family precedence.

arms.B: production native exact query over the canonical tables
arms.D: experimental native-Float mirror with named-field hydration
arms.M: experimental native-Float mirror with wildcard hydration
